title: opcua: X.509 Certificate dissection
description:
Dissect the X.509 v3 Certificates used in OPC UA.

Use proto_tree_add_bytes_with_length for adding NULL bytes to
the tree with a (0) length different than the length taken up
in the tvb. It's somewhat nicer than changing the item length later.

notes.body: @gergap, does this look okay to you? I thought it would be useful to parse the elements of the cert, but I'm not certain whether it makes sense to add it to `opcua_simpletypes` like this.

added 1 commit
  • 7ce05b9d - opcua: X.509 Certificate dissection
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14000/diffs?diff_id=892232836&start_sha=5309224f0523d6f51138548e88576807e89bef45)

I like that. There are also other locations in the service payload where we could replace parseByteString with parseCertificate. We would need to patch the generated files opcua_complextypeparser.c and opcua_serviceparser.c, though, because a) I don't have the generator working anymore, b) there is no semantic info in the XML nodesets that would allow to recognize if the ByteString is a certificate.
Maybe we could derive it from the variable name e.g. "ServerCertificate", "ClientCertificate", "SoftwareCertificates", etc. but this is not 100% safe.
For now I think manually patching would be the easiest approach.
